alt: A tall stepped Art Deco skyscraper rising above the low Manhattan skyline at sunset, seen across a harbour with tugboats and a ferry

provenance.prompt: Painterly digital illustration for a strategy-game encyclopedia, wide 16:9 landscape, warm golden-hour light with deep teal shadows, rich earthy palette, soft visible brushwork, clean readable silhouette. The main subject is centred and fully inside the middle 60% of the frame, with generous calm empty sky above and open space below it (nothing important in the top or bottom 15%, and the subject must not touch any edge; keep the whole tower small enough to fit with clear sky above its spire). No people in the foreground (tiny distant figures are fine). No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no watermark, no frame or border. Subject: the Empire State Building as it looked in 1931, a tall stepped Art Deco skyscraper with setbacks and a slender spire, seen from across the Hudson River at golden hour so the whole tower stands against the sky. Pale limestone and steel facade catching the warm light with rows of tall narrow windows, lower brick and stone buildings stepping down around it, the river in the foreground with a few small tugboats and a ferry, a low haze over the city. Natural evening light only, no illuminated lights or logos on the building, no lettering anywhere.
